metaTitle: Custom Recycled Luggage Accessories | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Brand custom recycled luggage accessories from Perfect Imprints. Eco-friendly tags and more for sustainable bulk orders.
introHtml: Recycled luggage accessories let you promote your brand while reducing waste. These tags and travel items are made from post-consumer materials like recycled felt, offering a textured, durable surface for imprinting your logo. Perfect for trade shows or corporate gifts, they show attendees you care about sustainability. Choose recycled options to align your promotional strategy with your company's green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom recycled luggage accessories including a recycled felt luggage tag with a branded logo and strap
